title: [AUG-195] Research: Active project session — precise mockups of the ASSISTANT overlay (P1) and the persistent `claude -p` session design
why_we_need_this: AUG-193 agreed: one persistent `claude -p --input-format stream-json` child process per (recording, Praxis project), shown as a right overlay «ASSISTANT» (P1) with project tabs, Praxis reached by Claude through its own MCP config, action items added through a small August MCP server. The user wants precise mockups of the panel in every state before implementation, and the process design must be verified against the real constraint: the user has no API key, Claude Code is signed in through the browser (OAuth). Source: @project-context/ai-assistants/README.md, @docs/mockups/AUG-193/assistant-panel.html.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Precise HTML mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-195/assistant-overlay.html, self-contained, on August's real tokens (overlay glass style of ControlsPanel AUG-154, 0 border-radius): pin bar [ SESSIONS ] [ CONTROLS ] [ ASSISTANT ], overlay 420 px with project chips (praxisProjects, Recent from AUG-192, Open…), tabs per project, chat log (user, assistant streaming, tool chips), input, «→ Action item» and «→ Praxis task» on a message, footer with spending so far / limit; states: no project yet, one project, two projects, PraxisOS not running, Claude Code missing/not signed in, budget reached, child crashed and resumed; Compact Mode `CTX n` badge on Dock Strip and Ghost Caption.
- [ ] Prototype outside the product tree (scratch script) proves on Windows: a persistent `claude -p --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages` child spawned from Node with cwd = a Praxis project, `--strict-mcp-config --mcp-config` (Praxis http + a stub August http MCP), `--tools Read,Grep,Glob`, `--allowedTools`, `--permission-prompts none`, `--setting-sources ""`, `--max-budget-usd`, `--session-id` + `--resume` after a kill — works under the browser (OAuth) login with no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; turn latencies and per-turn cost recorded; macOS run recorded or explicitly marked pending with the keychain question.
- [ ] Message contract written: WebSocket frames (assistant-start/ask/stop, assistant-status/delta/message), the August MCP server tools (get_recent_transcript, list_action_items, add_action_item with the similarity-0.6 dedup and the `assistant` item field), REST mirror POST /api/live/:liveKey/action-items, lifecycle rules (spawn on first question, idle stop 10 min, stop on End Meeting, max 3 children, LRU).
- [ ] System prompt for the child drafted (meeting assistant, answer in the meeting's language, create tasks only via Praxis create_task, note items via add_action_item, never edit files) and the transcript hand-off format (<recent_transcript window=N min>) specified.
- [ ] Decision recorded after the user reviews the mockup (AskUserQuestion); CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with SMART criteria and a link to the final mockup is created; its ID is written here and into the M4 roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no product code; prototypes live outside the product tree. Direction decided in AUG-193: persistent stream-json child, P1 overlay, Claude's own MCP to Praxis; do not re-open one-shot `claude -p` or P2/P3. No API key: the user authenticates Claude Code through the browser, so `--bare` is out. Transcript leaves the machine only inside a question turn and only with the consent from the Settings task. Cross-platform per @CLAUDE.md. Roadmap: M4 AI assistants.

Order: 2/3. Depends on: AUG-194-hinr8y (toggle, consent, status shape). Blocks: AUG-196-gxk1pv (the copilot explanation turn runs through this session). Parent research: AUG-193-bj5mw1.

## ⚠ Update from AUG-196 (decision of 2026-11-05)
- The copilot does NOT go through the chat child: it has its own copilot child per (liveKey, project) with `--tools ""` and only the praxis search_project_context / find_task_by_keywords tools. It counts toward AI_MAX_SESSIONS = 3. Measured on Windows under the OAuth login: init 0.7 s; Sonnet first turn 7 s / $0.056, then 1.4–1.5 s. Details: @docs/mockups/AUG-196/findings.md §3.
- Build the transport (ClaudeTransport, resolveClaudeCli, spawn/stop) as shared code: AUG-197 reuses it for the copilot child and the Always-on child.
- The ASSISTANT overlay gets a mode strip `COPILOT · <mode>` with mode and model selects (Haiku/Sonnet/Opus) and the Hints block above the chat; see @docs/mockups/AUG-196/copilot-hints.html.
- Compact Mode is no longer badge-only: Dock Strip gets the [ ◧ ] side drawer (A3, 320 px, the window widens to 660 px), and Ghost Caption gets the floating card (B3) with hint + Ask + answer; see @docs/mockups/AUG-196/compact-assistant.html. Plan the chat in compact widgets around these components.

## Result (2026-11-06) — implementation task: AUG-199-9csirf
- Prototype (Windows, Claude Code 2.1.318, browser login, no API key): passed. Init 0.7 s. Turn 1 with Praxis search 9.9 s / $0.12 (26k cache write, mostly 21 Praxis tool definitions). Later turns 3.6–4.3 s / $0.01. `--resume` after `taskkill /T /F` keeps the session id and memory. Budget → `error_max_budget_usd` with empty text. Logged out → `is_error: true` with "Not logged in". PraxisOS down → the child still answers. `total_cost_usd` is cumulative per process. macOS pending (Keychain question), carried into AUG-199.
- User review decisions: side-by-side Action items / Copilot / Assistant columns instead of the overlay (collapsible, hideable, resizable); compact Copilot and Assistant are separate movable, resizable, non-overlapping windows; no money in the panel; → Praxis task through Claude with direct fallback; chat model in Settings only. This supersedes AUG-193 D4 "P1 overlay" and AUG-196 A3/B3; AUG-197 was updated.
- Files: @docs/mockups/AUG-195/assistant-overlay.html (final), @docs/mockups/AUG-195/findings.md (results, contract, prompt), @docs/mockups/AUG-195/research/session-proto.mjs + results-win.json.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-06)
**Что сделано:**
- Доказано на Windows: постоянный `claude -p` stream-json child работает под браузерным логином Claude Code без API-ключа, с Praxis MCP и stub-сервером `august` (add_action_item с дедупом), `--resume` после жёсткого kill сохраняет разговор.
- Замерены задержки и цена: 1-й ход $0.12 / 9.9 с, дальше ≈ $0.01 / 3.6–4.3 с; сигналы ошибок (лимит, не залогинен, PraxisOS выключен).
- Написан контракт: lifecycle-таблица, WebSocket-фреймы, `august` MCP + REST mirror, формат передачи транскрипта, SESSION_PROMPT.
- Макет всех 10 состояний; после ревью — колонки рядом вместо оверлея и отдельные непересекающиеся окна в Compact Mode.
- Создана задача реализации AUG-199; AUG-197 и роадмап M4 обновлены.
**Как:** прототип — scratch-скрипт на node-built-ins (без зависимостей) вне продукта; чат-child получает явный список 6 praxis-инструментов вместо `mcp__praxis__*` (цена 1-го хода и защита от update_task_status/update_settings). Отвергнуто: оверлей P1 (перекрывал Action items, нет места копайлоту), деньги в панели, A3-drawer/B3-карточка AUG-196, выбор модели чата в панели.
**Файлы:** @docs/mockups/AUG-195/assistant-overlay.html, @docs/mockups/AUG-195/findings.md, @docs/mockups/AUG-195/research/session-proto.mjs, @docs/mockups/AUG-195/research/results-win.json, @project-context/ai-assistants/README.md (D12), @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
**PR / коммиты:** ещё не влито в master (изменения в рабочем дереве, коммита нет).
**Грабли:** `total_cost_usd` кумулятивный в пределах процесса и обнуляется после respawn — считать дельту; при «не залогинен» subtype = `success`, проверять `is_error`; лимит → `error_max_budget_usd` с пустым текстом, процесс жив; `system/init` приходит только после первого сообщения. Сессия прервалась BSOD — ревизия макета перезапущена с нуля, потерь нет.
**Хвосты:** прогон на macOS (Keychain из GUI-приложения) и замер цены 1-го хода с урезанным списком инструментов — в AUG-199; drag/resize в макете в живом браузере руками не проверялись.
